lines.en: label beachmas19:
scene clearnightsky
Carry on my name; as if it is your own.
lines.zh: 把我的名字延续下去吧；就当它是你自己的。

lines.en: If I can live inside of you, we’ll never be alone.
lines.zh: 只要我能活在你的体内，我们就永远不会孤单。

lines.en: So when I’m gone, remove your heart.\nI’ll give you mine instead.
lines.zh:
所以当我离去，摘下你的心脏。
我把我的给你。

lines.en: And when that’s done, remove your brain-\nLet {i}me{/i} into your head.
lines.zh:
等那之后，摘下你的大脑——
让{i}我{/i}进入你的头颅。

lines.en: The world won’t understand us- that’s why we lock the doors.
lines.zh: 这世界不会理解我们——所以我们要把门锁上。

lines.en: That’s why we board the windows — lay our blankets on the floor.
lines.zh: 所以我们要把窗户钉死——把毯子铺在地板上。

lines.en: The softest of materials, half a step from what’s ethereal,\nMy love for you’s bacterial! I’ve never wanted more!
lines.zh:
最柔软的材质，离空灵只差半步，
我对你的爱是菌类！我从未奢求更多！

lines.en: Than to be the one you see at night.
lines.zh: 只奢求成为你夜里看见的那个人。

lines.en: You’re my Edgar.\nLove, Lenore.
lines.zh:
你是我的 Edgar。
爱你的，Lenore。

lines.en: Words!
lines.zh: 文字！

lines.en: Combinations of lines! Compressed into strands with the right amount of pressure and skill!
lines.zh: 线条的组合！在恰到好处的压力与技巧下被压缩成股！

lines.en: Compact meanings into ropes! Ropes that we can use to bind what we are afraid of losing! To keep it all in one place!
lines.zh: 把意义压实成绳索！我们可以用这些绳索，捆住我们害怕失去的东西！好让它全都留在一个地方！

lines.en: Untie me! Remove the bindings in my head and recreate what once lived outside of it!
lines.zh: 解开我！拆掉我脑袋里的束缚，重建那个曾经活在它之外的东西！

lines.en: Amalgamation of unwanted flesh! Patchwork carbon being! You are the me who should not be me!
lines.zh: 不受欢迎的肉体的混合体！拼凑而成的碳基存在！你就是那个不该是我的我！

lines.en: {b}YOU HAVE DONE NOTHING!{/b}
lines.zh: {b}你什么都没做成！{/b}

lines.en: And you are not even here.
lines.zh: 而你甚至不在这里。

lines.en: scene fireflies1
But I am.
lines.zh: 但我在。

lines.en: And I am more sentient than ever.
lines.zh: 而且我比以往任何时候都更有知觉。

lines.en: For I have discovered what is important in a way that does not thrust me into the darkest pits of this unwanted mind.
lines.zh: 因为我发现了什么是重要的——而且是以一种不会把我推进这颗不受欢迎的头脑中最黑暗深渊的方式。

lines.en: I have LIVED through the end of days and am prepared to face the demons I create or she creates or it creates or demons as a whole.
lines.zh: 我活过了末日，并已准备好面对我创造的、她创造的、它创造的恶魔，或者恶魔这个整体。

lines.en: I am prepared to fight for what I cherish in the face of the holy and will sodomize the omnipowerful rectum of any intervening god with my dramatically impressive cock.
lines.zh: 我已准备好为我在神圣面前珍视的东西而战，并且会用我那惊人壮观的鸡巴，鸡奸任何插手其中的神那全能的直肠。

lines.en: This is MY world and MY life and YOU have NO place HERE.
lines.zh: 这是我的世界、我的人生，而你在这里毫无立足之地。

lines.en: scene fireflies2
But she does.
lines.zh: 但她有。

lines.en: And looking at her makes me feel normal again.
lines.zh: 而看着她，让我重新觉得自己是个正常人。

lines.en: : Let’s get one thing straight. The only reason I wanted to see you was so I could complain about your inadequacies as a reset partner.
lines.zh: : 先把一件事说清楚。我想见你的唯一理由，就是好抱怨一下你作为重置搭档有多不称职。

lines.en: : Cool. Merry Christmas to you as well.
lines.zh: : 酷。也祝你圣诞快乐。

lines.en: : Where were you?
lines.zh: : 你去哪儿了？

lines.en: : Why does it matter?
lines.zh: : 这有什么关系？

lines.en: : Because everyone is vying for your attention tonight and it’s too suspicious to keep wandering off like that without saying anything to anyone.
lines.zh: : 因为今晚所有人都在抢你的注意力，而你那样一声不吭地到处乱晃，实在太可疑了。

lines.en: : Right. So I’m assuming that means you informed the rest of the class that you were going to be contacting me when you {i}also{/i} wandered off?
lines.zh: : 是啊。那我是不是可以理解为，你{i}也{/i}通知了全班，说你要跑来跟我联系？

lines.en: scene fireflies3
: Don’t be ridiculous. The only person who has an inkling of what I’m doing out here is Ayane and that is certainly not because I {i}told{/i} her.
lines.zh: : 别荒唐了。唯一一个对我的行踪有点察觉的人是 Ayane，而这当然不是因为我{i}告诉{/i}她的。

lines.en: : Then why do you think she knows?
lines.zh: : 那你凭什么觉得她知道？

lines.en: : Because she sent me a text message telling me to tell you she says “Hi.”
lines.zh: : 因为她给我发了条短信，让我转告你，她向你问好。

lines.en: : Oh. Tell her I say “Hi” as well, then.
lines.zh: : 哦。那也替我向她问好吧。

lines.en: : Tell her yourself. You’re essentially inseparable at this point, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你自己跟她说。你们现在基本上形影不离了吧？

lines.en: : By the universe’s definition, yes. But that would just mean you and I are inseparable as well.
lines.zh: : 按宇宙的定义，是的。但那也就意味着，你和我也同样形影不离。

lines.en: : Don’t remind me.
lines.zh: : 别提醒我。

lines.en: : We’re inseparable.
lines.zh: : 我们形影不离。

lines.en: scene fireflies4
: Just as bad at following directions as ever, I see.
lines.zh: : 看来你还是跟以前一样不擅长听指挥。

lines.en: : The ones I disagree with, yes. But I do often follow the rules that benefit me in some way.
lines.zh: : 我不同意的那些，确实。但凡是能以某种方式让我受益的规则，我倒是经常遵守。

lines.en: : That doesn’t make you good at following directions, it makes you a narcissist. But you’re pretty horrible at that as well since you’re always walking around feeling sorry for yourself.
lines.zh: : 那不叫擅长听指挥，那叫自恋。不过你连自恋都做得很烂，因为你成天走来走去地自怨自艾。

lines.en: : You know you-
lines.zh: : 你知不知道你——

lines.en: : I could have had sex with Noriko tonight.
lines.zh: : 我今晚本来可以和 Noriko 上床。

lines.en: scene fireflies5
: Oh, how nice. Thank you for randomly reminding me that she’s a desperate cunt who-
lines.zh: : 哦，真好。谢谢你突然提醒我，她是个饥渴的贱货，她——

lines.en: : I left because you texted me.
lines.zh: : 我离开，是因为你给我发了短信。

lines.en: scene fireflies6
: You...what?
lines.zh: : 你……什么？

lines.en: : I’m just saying that if you’re going to keep rambling on about how much I suck, that you should at least know that.
lines.zh: : 我只是说，如果你还要继续絮叨我有多差劲，那你至少该知道这件事。

lines.en: : Does choosing a sexless meeting with you over deflowering your rival earn me any points? And if so, can I cash some of them in for a chance to sit next to you? My legs are tired.
lines.zh: : 选择跟你进行一次无性的会面，而不是给你的对手开苞，能给我加点分吗？如果可以，我能兑换一些，换个坐在你旁边的机会吗？我腿酸了。

lines.en: scene fireflies7
: Fine. Sit.
lines.zh: : 行。坐吧。

lines.en: : But I’m not going to thank you for not being an insatiable predator for the first time in your-
lines.zh: : 但我不会谢谢你——谢你这么多年来第一次没有当个欲求不满的捕食者——

lines.en: scene black
: Thanks. Move over.
lines.zh: : 谢了。让开点。

lines.en: : You fucking...
lines.zh: : 你他妈的……

lines.en: scene fireflies8
: Where did this sudden...sassy attitude come from? I ask you to come see me {i}one time{/i} and now you’re treating me like I can’t live without you?
lines.zh: : 这股突然冒出来的……傲娇劲儿是从哪儿来的？我就叫你来见我{i}一次{/i}，现在你就当我是离了你就活不下去了？

lines.en: : You got me.
lines.zh: : 被你说中了。

lines.en: : I should have just stayed at the inn.
lines.zh: : 我当初就该待在旅馆里。

lines.en: : Probably.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。

lines.en: : That would have made Noriko a lot happier, at least.
lines.zh: : 至少那样 Noriko 会开心很多。

lines.en: scene fireflies9
: You’re disgusting.
lines.zh: : 你真恶心。

lines.en: : I know.
lines.zh: : 我知道。

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: : 不过……

lines.en: : I’m thankful you did come.
lines.zh: : 我还是很庆幸你来了。

lines.en: : And I was lying when I said the only reason was to call you out for your inadequacies as a reset partner.
lines.zh: : 而且我刚才说，想见你只是为了指责你作为重置搭档不称职——那是骗你的。

lines.en: : I know.
lines.zh: : 我知道。

lines.en: scene fireflies10
: I guess that makes this the second Christmas in a row where you were late for a meeting with me because of her.
lines.zh: : 这么说来，这大概是你连续第二个圣诞节，因为她而迟到了和我的会面。

lines.en: : Except my actual meeting with you was technically yesterday and I had no idea this one was even happening until I was already on my way.
lines.zh: : 可我跟你真正的会面严格来说是昨天，而且直到我都在路上了，我才知道还有这一场。

lines.en: : Your initial reaction to realizing you abandoned me should have been to reschedule.
lines.zh: : 你意识到自己抛下我，第一反应应该是重新约时间。

lines.en: : I’ve had plans with Noriko since yesterday.
lines.zh: : 我从昨天起就约好了要和 Noriko 见面。

lines.en: : Oh, okay. So you just remembered your meeting with {i}her{/i} and not me. I get it now.
lines.zh: : 哦，好吧。所以你只记得和{i}她{/i}有约，不记得我。我懂了。

lines.en: : I know how it sounds. But last night was kind of...weird. And you could have just texted me to remind me anyway.
lines.zh: : 我知道这听起来很糟。但昨晚有点……奇怪。再说，你本来也可以发短信提醒我的。

lines.en: : What made last night any weirder than any {i}other{/i} night as the man with the world’s most active libido?
lines.zh: : 昨晚有什么特别的，比你这个「世界上性欲最旺盛的男人」的{i}任何一个{/i}夜晚都奇怪？

lines.en: : Probably the part where I passed out on the beach for no reason whatsoever. Or the part where Tsuneyo might subconsciously know that the world is resetting.
lines.zh: : 大概是我毫无理由地昏倒在海滩上那部分。或者是 Tsuneyo 可能在潜意识里知道世界在重置那部分。

lines.en: scene fireflies11
: Wait, what? Why do you say that?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？你为什么这么说？

lines.en: : She said something about feeling like everything is going in circles sometimes.
lines.zh: : 她说了些关于有时觉得一切都在绕圈的话。

lines.en: : That’s...not really enough to go off of.
lines.zh: : 那……光凭这个可说明不了什么。

lines.en: : Maybe not on its own. But Yumi seemed to be a little confused as well...and couldn’t even remember anything that happened between Halloween and now.
lines.zh: : 也许单凭这个不行。但 Yumi 看起来也有点困惑……甚至完全想不起万圣节到现在之间发生的任何事。

lines.en: : Were you...actually trying to figure things out instead of just preying upon our class the last two nights?
lines.zh: : 你这两天晚上……是真的在想办法搞明白，而不是只顾着在班上猎食？

lines.en: : Unexpected side effect.
lines.zh: : 意外的副作用。

lines.en: : But why...those two? I didn’t think you were particularly close with either of them.
lines.zh: : 可为什么……是她们两个？我以为你跟她们谁都不算特别亲近。

lines.en: : I’m not. But it’s not like I surveyed every single girl in class about their knowledge of the last two months. It’s just stuff I figured out while {i}preying upon the class.{/i}
lines.zh: : 是不亲近。但我又没去挨个调查班上每个女生对这两个月的了解。只是在{i}猎食{/i}的过程中顺带发现的东西。

lines.en: scene fireflies12
: Huh...
: You {i}were{/i} talking to Yumi during the jump from the Dorm Wars to Christmas, so...I guess it would make sense for her to be at least slightly confused about that?
lines.zh: : 从 Dorm Wars 跳到圣诞那会儿，你{i}正在{/i}跟 Yumi 说话，所以……她至少对这件事有点困惑，倒也说得通？

lines.en: : Nothing similar has ever happened before, so it might be something worth looking into.
lines.zh: : 以前从没发生过类似的事，所以这也许值得查一查。

lines.en: : Got it. I’ll be sure to get her pregnant before the next reset comes so we can really start pressing her about it.
lines.zh: : 明白了。那我一定会在下次重置来临之前让她怀上，这样我们就能真正开始逼问她了。

lines.en: scene fireflies13
: Or, you can {i}not{/i} get anyone pregnant because it’s utterly repulsive and babies are evil.
lines.zh: : 或者，你可以{i}谁都别{/i}搞怀孕，因为那恶心透顶，而且婴儿是邪恶的。

lines.en: : You and Ayane really couldn’t be any further off if you tried.
lines.zh: : 你和 Ayane 就算再怎么努力，也没法差得更远了。

lines.en: scene fireflies14
: We’re not...that far off from one another.
lines.zh: : 我们……没有那么南辕北辙。

lines.en: : We have many of the same values. Just...incredibly different ways of approaching and confronting them.
lines.zh: : 我们有很多相同的价值观。只是……处理和面对它们的方式截然不同。

lines.en: : How are things with you two, by the way?
lines.zh: : 顺便问一句，你俩现在怎么样？

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 什么意思？

lines.en: : Just that she’s seemed kind of suspicious of you ever since you started trying to prevent her from making it to the rooftop again.
lines.zh: : 只是说，自从你开始阻止她再上天台以来，她看起来一直有点怀疑你。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t be doing that if I {i}wasn’t{/i} suspicious of her.
lines.zh: : 如果我{i}不{/i}怀疑她，我也不会那么做。

lines.en: : I think, at the current moment, there is no conceivable way for Ayane and me to {i}not{/i} be suspicious of one another.
lines.zh: : 我觉得，就目前而言，我和 Ayane 之间根本不可能{i}不{/i}互相怀疑。

lines.en: : From my perspective, she’s...kind of like a glitch. Something that doesn’t belong here and something that needs to have the root cause ironed out so it doesn’t keep happening.
lines.zh: : 在我看来，她……有点像个故障。一个不属于这里的东西，一个需要把根本原因理顺、以免继续发生的东西。

lines.en: : But from her perspective, it probably seems like I’m just trying to keep you to myself.
lines.zh: : 但在她看来，大概会觉得我只是在想把你据为己有。

lines.en: : Are you not?
lines.zh: : 难道不是吗？

lines.en: : Of course not. Why would I ever do something like that?
lines.zh: : 当然不是。我为什么要做那种事？

lines.en: : Because you’re in love with me.
lines.zh: : 因为你爱着我。

lines.en: : Oh, joy. Here we go again.
lines.zh: : 哦，真高兴。又来了。

lines.en: : Why even deny it at this point, Maya?
lines.zh: : 事到如今，你为什么还要否认，Maya？

lines.en: : Why keep bringing it up if it’s something I’ve already informed you I can’t speak about?
lines.zh: : 既然我已经告诉过你，这件事我无法说出口，你为什么还要一直提？

lines.en: : Probably because I’m in love with you.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为我爱着你。

lines.en: scene fireflies15
: What did you just say?
lines.zh: : 你刚才说什么？

lines.en: : Don’t make me say it again. I hate this kind of stuff.
lines.zh: : 别让我再说一遍。我讨厌这种事。

lines.en: scene fireflies16
: Say it again.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍。

lines.en: : No.
: Seriously. Say it again.
lines.zh: : 说真的。再说一遍。

lines.en: scene fireflies17
: Why? So you can tease me for it?
lines.zh: : 为什么？好让你拿这个取笑我？

lines.en: : Tease you for what? What did you say?
lines.zh: : 取笑你什么？你说了什么？

lines.en: : That I love you.
lines.zh: : 说我爱你。

lines.en: scene fireflies18
: How...
lines.zh: : 怎么……

lines.en: : How is your brain not exploding right now?!
lines.zh: : 你的脑子怎么现在没炸开？！

lines.en: : You’re not supposed to be able to say things like that to me!
lines.zh: : 你不该能对我说这种话的！

lines.en: : Why not?
lines.zh: : 为什么不能？

lines.en: : Because...Because things have broken down every time I’ve tried to say them to you!
lines.zh: : 因为……因为每次我想对你说这些的时候，一切都会崩坏！

lines.en: : Do you have any idea how many times I’ve  done it?! How many {i}yous{/i} have gone away because I just did the same exact thing {i}you{/i} just did?!
lines.zh: : 你知道我试过多少次吗？！有多少个{i}「你」{/i}，因为我做了跟{i}你{/i}刚才一模一样的事而消失？！

lines.en: : Why does that suddenly not matter anymore?! Are the rules gone?! What the fuck is this?!
lines.zh: : 为什么那件事突然就不重要了？！规则没了吗？！这到底是他妈怎么回事？！

lines.en: : Say it back and find out.
lines.zh: : 说回来，你就知道了。

lines.en: scene fireflies19
: I can’t!
lines.zh: : 我说不出口！

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Because I’m scared!
lines.zh: : 因为我害怕！

lines.en: : No words are worth risking you over!
lines.zh: : 没有哪句话值得拿你去冒险！

lines.en: : Then show me without words.
lines.zh: : 那就不用语言，做给我看。

lines.en: : Without...words?
lines.zh: : 不用……语言？

lines.en: : Is that okay?
lines.zh: : 那样可以吗？

lines.en: scene fireflies20
: That’s never worked either...
lines.zh: : 那样也从来没成功过……

lines.en: : And to think just minutes ago you were talking about how horrible I am as a person.
lines.zh: : 想想几分钟前，你还在说我这个人有多糟糕。

lines.en: : You {i}are{/i} horrible! You’re the worst! Deplorable! Degenerate! An evil...{i}evil{/i} man!
lines.zh: : 你{i}就是{/i}很糟糕！你是最差劲的！卑鄙！堕落！一个邪恶的……{i}邪恶{/i}的男人！

lines.en: : What else?
lines.zh: : 还有呢？

lines.en: : Pervert! Lecher! Debauchee!
lines.zh: : 变态！色鬼！纵欲之徒！

lines.en: : Everything evil and everything worse!
lines.zh: : 一切邪恶，以及比邪恶更糟的东西！

lines.en: : And?
lines.zh: : 还有呢？

lines.en: scene fireflies21
: And...
lines.zh: : 还有……

lines.en: : If the world ends right now, I won’t care.
lines.zh: : 如果世界现在就结束，我不会在乎。

lines.en: : I’ll find you again.
lines.zh: : 我会再次找到你。

lines.en: : As many times as it takes.
lines.zh: : 无论要多少次。

lines.en: : You still haven’t said anything...
lines.zh: : 你还是什么都没说……

lines.en: : I’ve never had much of a way with words.
lines.zh: : 我从来就不太会用语言表达。

lines.en: : I liked your second idea better.
lines.zh: : 我更喜欢你的第二个主意。

lines.en: scene fireflies22
: Oh, wonderful! I’ve been looking all-
lines.zh: : 哦，太好了！我一直在找——

lines.en: scene fireflies23
: Ah! Never mind! I was never here and didn’t see anything! Please go back to having your moment and feel free to entirely disregard my existence from this point onward!
lines.zh: : 啊！当我没说！我从没来过，什么都没看见！请继续你们的时刻，从现在起请完全无视我的存在！

lines.en: : Moment? What moment? We weren’t doing anything weird. I don’t even like Sensei.
lines.zh: : 时刻？什么时刻？我们没在做什么奇怪的事。我甚至不喜欢老师。

lines.en: : Why would I ever have a moment with someone who spends the entire day insulting me?
lines.zh: : 我怎么会跟一个整天侮辱我的人有什么时刻？

lines.en: : And why would {i}I{/i} ever have a moment with an adult? I’m a normal teenage girl with normal teenage interests and preferences.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}又怎么会跟一个成年人有什么时刻？我是个有着正常青春期爱好和喜好的普通少女。

lines.en: : Yeah. Maya’s too short and her chest is too small for me.
lines.zh: : 是啊。而且 Maya 对我来说太矮了，胸也太小。

lines.en: : {i}Okay, that wasn’t necessary and is also blatantly untrue.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}好了，那句没必要说，而且明显不是事实。{/i}

lines.en: scene fireflies24
: I’m not sure if I believe any of that when you both sound so much different from the way you normally speak...and are also so close in physical proximity to one another...
lines.zh: : 我也不确定我该不该信——毕竟你俩说话的语气跟平时差太多了……而且身体还靠得那么近……

lines.en: scene black
scene fireflies25
: {i}Ahem.{/i}
: So...that was an interesting and informative platonic meeting we just had. Right, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 那么……我们刚才进行了一场既有趣又涨知识的、柏拉图式的会面。对吧，老师？

lines.en: : Yeah. It was interesting and informative and completely free of anything inappropriate between teacher and student.
lines.zh: : 对。既有趣又涨知识，师生之间完全没有发生任何不当之事。

lines.en: : Just so the two of you are aware and can put an end to this terrible game of charades, I have no intention of telling anyone what I saw.
lines.zh: : 先跟两位说清楚，也好让你们结束这场糟糕的字谜游戏：我无意把看到的说出去。

lines.en: : Saw what? You didn’t see anything.
lines.zh: : 看到什么？你什么都没看见。

lines.en: : Yeah. Nothing happened. And if anything did happen, it would have all been one big misunderstanding.
lines.zh: : 对。什么都没发生。就算真发生了什么，也都只是个天大的误会。

lines.en: : Yup.
: R...Right...
scene fireflies26
: So, uhh...Touka! What...are {i}you{/i} doing over here?
lines.zh: : 那么，呃……Touka！{i}你{/i}……在这儿干什么？

lines.en: : I...was assigned Sensei for Secret Santa this year and, considering the slightly time-sensitive nature of his present, was out looking for him before my driver returns to the manor.
lines.zh: : 我……今年 Secret Santa 抽到了老师，考虑到他那份礼物有点时效性，我趁着司机还没回宅邸，出来找他。

lines.en: : Driver? Your present involves going somewhere?
lines.zh: : 司机？你的礼物还要去某个地方？

lines.en: scene fireflies27
: It does. But I’m afraid we must leave right now as I’ve already kept him waiting for far longer than I would have liked due to my hesitancy regarding the matter.
lines.zh: : 是的。但恐怕我们现在就得走了，因为我在这件事上犹豫了太久，已经让他等得比我愿意的久多了。

lines.en: : Can it maybe wait until another time? Maya and I-
lines.zh: : 能不能改天再说？Maya 和我——

lines.en: : No! Now is fine! Go! I’m gonna...uhh...
lines.zh: : 不！现在就行！走吧！我要去……呃……

lines.en: : I’m gonna go for a walk! Platonically, of course! Which doesn’t really make sense because it’s just a walk by myself and...
lines.zh: : 我要去散步！当然是柏拉图式的！虽然这么说其实不太通，因为就是我自己一个人散步，而且……

lines.en: : Hahah! Anyway, bye!
lines.zh: : 哈哈！总之，拜拜！

lines.en: scene fireflies28
: Maya-
lines.zh: : Maya——

lines.en: : See you! Bye! Tell Ami I- ack!
lines.zh: : 再见！拜拜！替我跟 Ami 说——啊！

lines.en: : Maya, please face forward when you’re walking. There are many large rocks on this beach and it would be dangerous to have you tripping over more of them.
lines.zh: : Maya，走路的时候请看着前面。这片海滩上有很多大石头，你要是再被绊倒就危险了。

lines.en: : I’m okay! Bye!
lines.zh: : 我没事！拜拜！

lines.en: scene fireflies29
: Well, that was certainly a side of her I’ve never seen before.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那可真是我从没见过的、她的一面。

lines.en: : Yeah...same.
lines.zh: : 是啊……我也是。

lines.en: : Sensei, I truly am sorry for interrupting what appeared to be such an important moment between you two. But seeing as the driver is waiting-
lines.zh: : 老师，真的很抱歉，打断了你们之间看起来那么重要的时刻。不过既然司机在等——

lines.en: : Yeah, we can go. And thanks for...coming to find me, I guess.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我们可以走了。还有，谢谢你……来找我，算是吧。

lines.en: : You either showed up at the worst possible time or the best.
lines.zh: : 你要么是在最糟的时机出现的，要么是在最好的时机。

lines.en: : I’m not really sure yet...
lines.zh: : 我还不太确定是哪一个……

lines.en: scene black
